lines.text: Rain drums on a greenhouse roof while @maya_front repots a small tomato plant, humming to herself.
Rain sound up; soft focus outside.

new_beats.text: Some of the best days start slowly, with a little rain.

writes.note: I added a short VO line that sits over the rain and the repotting.

reply.rationale: Kept the shot's words and added one calm VO beat that fits the quiet mood and leaves room for the humming.
